findings.title: The v5 selector chooses two role outputs that their own collision arbitration records mark unselectable.
evidence: C3-ASSET selects role-receipts/asset-auditor-batch-c-v4.json and role-proofs/asset-auditor-batch-c-v4.json. batch-c-asset-auditor-v4-collision.json says both competing v4 provider sets are preserved, neither may be selected, v4_selection_authorized is false, and a genuinely fresh v5 successor is required.

C3-MAP-GRYPHON selects role-receipts/requirements-mapper-gryphon-patrol-batch-c-v5.json and its proof. batch-c-gryphon-mapper-v5-collision.json declares that v5 invalid, freezes it, and says v5_selection_authorized is false. The root-arbiter ownership record permits consideration only for a complete coherent v6 successor on five reserved paths; those successor outputs are not selected by v5.
findings.impact: The role-selection prerequisite is self-contradictory for two of eight active roles. Hash-valid receipts cannot override the preserved owner arbitration, so fresh role isolation and downstream candidate eligibility are not established.
findings.required_remediation: Do not consume either selected collision-invalid set. Complete the collision records' designated fresh successor process and publish a selector that explicitly binds only authorized, internally coherent outputs.
